toegepas.blok: Lyn, vorm en kleur in letters en patrone
toegepas.rede_vinder: For two colours contrasting with each other, 'teen mekaar afsteek' is the idiomatic Afrikaans; 'teen mekaar uitstaan' is less natural.
toegepas.fout: 'teen mekaar uitstaan' copies English 'stand out against'; Afrikaans says colours 'steek teen mekaar af' for contrast.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The fixed Afrikaans expression for contrasting colours replaces a loose calque, and the meaning (strong contrast between the pair) is unchanged; the neighbouring block's 'uitstaan' for emphasis is untouched.

toegepas.voor: Dieselfde woorde geld ook vir die liggaam.
toegepas.na: Dieselfde woorde geld ook vir liggaamsversiering.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The art-element words apply to the decoration, not to the body itself; naming the lesson's own term makes the sentence say what it means.
toegepas.fout: 'geld ook vir die liggaam' is loose: the art-element words apply to the decoration on the body, not to the body itself.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the lesson's own term makes the sentence say exactly what it means without adding or losing any content.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A bare 'so' at the end of the sentence is vague for Grade 5; 'op dié manier' makes the link back to the previous sentences clear.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: A sentence-final 'so' pointing back to the examples is natural Afrikaans and clear in context; the proposal is a lateral and longer move.

laat_vaar.voor: na letters en patrone en na 'n kraalkraag
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The double 'en ... en na' is clumsy; a plain list of three reads more smoothly with the same meaning.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original groups 'letters en patrone' (surface design) apart from 'n kraalkraag' (body decoration), which carries the lesson's two kinds; flattening it into a list of three loses that grouping and the original reads well.

laat_vaar.blok: Jou eie werk en jou omgewing
laat_vaar.voor: Sê dan met hierdie les se woorde wat jy sien.
laat_vaar.na: Gebruik dan hierdie les se woorde om te sê wat jy sien.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The inserted phrase between 'Sê' and its object makes the sentence hard to follow; this order is clearer for Grade 5.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Sê dan met hierdie les se woorde wat jy sien' is ordinary, readable Afrikaans word order; the proposal is longer without being clearly better.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Mee' needs something to refer to; 'om dinge mee te kleur' is the complete, standard construction.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'om mee te kleur' is grammatical, with 'mee' referring back to the ground being described, so there is no grammar fault that would justify rewording a glossary definition.

vlae.teks: Baie klein krale styf langs mekaar gee 'n knopperige tekstuur.
vlae.rede: 'Baie klein krale' can be read as 'very small beads' or 'many small beads'; 'baie' is protected and the intended meaning cannot be chosen without guessing, so the writer should decide.

vlae.teks: 'n Gekleurde grond, soos rooi of geel, wat mense fynmaak om mee te kleur.
vlae.rede: 'soos rooi of geel' attaches to 'grond', so it reads as if a soil is like a colour; a rewording such as naming red or yellow soil would be clearer, but it touches a definition, so it is left to the reviewer or writer.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Die nuwe derde soort is liggaamsversiering in Afrika.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Die derde soort, liggaamsversiering in Afrika, is nuut.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Die nuwe derde soort' stacks two adjectives awkwardly; saying it is new at the end reads more naturally with the same word count.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The original reads acceptably; the appositive with two commas is a lateral move and slightly harder for a Grade 5 reader.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Rondom' is the natural word for the words surrounding another word; 'om hom' reads clipped.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Die woorde om hom' is natural Afrikaans (as in 'die mense om hom'); 'rondom' is a lateral swap.
